 Order
This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

This writ petition has been filed with a prayer to direct the Collector, Puri, Opposite Party No.2 to pay compensation and all statutory benefits to the petitioner within a stipulated time by strictly adhering to the provisions of the Act No.30 of 2013 for acquisition of her sthitiban land measuring Ac.0.54 decimals appertaining to Hal Khata No.146, Hal Plot No.451/923 at Mouza- Madhipur,
Tahasil-Nimapara, District-Puri for construction of school building.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has made a representation before the Collector, Puri, Opposite Party No.2 on 07.06.2024 vide Annexure-3 and the same is still pending for consideration and necessary direction be issued for early disposal of the appeal.
Learned counsel for the State has no serious objection to such prayer.
For the nature of relief sought for and for pendency of the representation at the instance of the Petitioner vide Annexure-3 on the self same grounds, this writ petition is disposed of directing Jhanamani Dei @ vs The State Of Odisha & ....
